description: Write a new order to a supplier. It is created as a DRAFT — nothing reaches the supplier and no stock moves until send_purchase_order. PREREQUISITES, in this order: get_suppliers for the supplierId, get_outlets for the outlet the goods will be delivered INTO, then get_supplier_items WITH that outletId for the lines — variantId and unitCost come from there, and an item that is not linked to this supplier is refused. unitCost is what the merchant pays per unit as a human amount ("12.50"), prefilled from the supplier link but editable if this order was negotiated differently. quantity is in the item’s selling unit and may be fractional for goods sold by weight or length. Read the lines back to the merchant with the total before sending — a wrong quantity here becomes wrong stock later.

customFees.description: Any other named charge on the order, e.g. "Handling"

discount.description: Flat discount on the whole order, e.g. "25.00". Not with discountPercent

discountPercent.description: Discount as a percentage of the items subtotal

dutyFees.description: Duty / customs charged on the order

expectedDate.description: ISO date the merchant expects delivery

discount.description: Flat discount on this line, e.g. "2.00". Not with discountPercent

discountPercent.description: Discount as a percentage of this line’s goods

feePerUnit.description: Extra cost per unit on this line

quantity.description: How many, in the unit the item is sold in. May be fractional for goods sold by weight or length

unitCost.description: Cost per unit the merchant pays, e.g. "12.50". Never cents, never the selling price

variantId.description: Item id from get_supplier_items — the supplier must carry it

notes.description: Note for the supplier / for the merchant’s own records

outletId.description: Outlet id from get_outlets — where the goods will be received

shippingFee.description: Shipping charged on the order, e.g. "18.00"

name: hub_create_purchase_order
title: Create purchase order
